segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the cleanser removes oil and makeup without stripping, leaving skin balanced rather than greasy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently describe the cleanser as hydrating, non-tightening and non-stripping, though one long-term user (age 70) simply calls it a lasting favorite.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including those with an oily T-zone or dry patches, describe balanced, non-drying cleansing and reduced pore appearance.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers identifying as sensitive report no irritation and a gentle, hydrating cleanse, with one noting it works well for sensitive skin specifically.
segments.mature: One long-term user in her 70s calls it a repurchase staple, and another reviewer using it with other Pro-Collagen products reports softer fine lines around eyes and mouth.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers across skin types report the cleanser leaves skin hydrated, soft and not tight or stripped after rinsing; two reviewers report flakiness around the mouth after repeated use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as gentle enough for daily double-cleansing without disrupting the skin's natural oils or causing tightness.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the cleanser removes excess oil and controls shine without over-drying, with one noting reduced oil throughout the day.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with acne-prone, oily skin reports no new breakouts since starting use.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers using it alongside other Pro-Collagen products report a more youthful, plumper look and softer fine lines, though this is described alongside routine use rather than the cleanser alone.
concerns.redness: One sensitive-skin reviewer reports no irritation or bad reactions after use.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewers report worsening of blemishes; one oily/acne-prone user reports clear skin with continued use.

aspects.libelle: Long-lasting, little goes a long way

extraits.texte: Unfortunately this cleanser made my skin flaky around mouth so I had to discontinue.

This cleanser has been a great match for my oily, acne-prone skin. It cleans thoroughly without stripping or drying me out, and I haven't had any breakouts since I started using it. While I usually prefer fragrance-free products, the scent is mild and not too overpowering. Overall, a gentle and effective cleanser I'd definitely recommend. I received this product complimentary from Elemis.

Complimentary from elemis. Strong aroma, a bit intrusive, which I didn't like. Gel texture, foams well. After use, the skin does not feel dry and tight. It looks restored, fresh. The gel washes away all dirt and oil well. I have combination skin, normal with an oily T-zone. Completely satisfied.

extraits.titre: Perfect cleanser for dry skin type.
extraits.texte: I received this new Pro-Collagen Energising Marine Cleanser complimentary from Elemis in exchange for my honest opinion. I have dry skin and this cleanser left my skin feeling hydrated after washing . The texture is gel like and doesn't leave your skin dry or stripped. You only need a pea size on damp skin to break up the makeup or sunscreen. Then I wash it out with warm water . All my makeup or sunscreen comes of completely. Perfect gentle cleanser for dry skin type .

I haven't had any irritation or bad reactions, which is a big deal for my sensitive skin. The texture is nice and it lathers well, making it feel like a small spa moment every time I use it. Overall, really happy with it! Complimentary from elemis

I'm very pleased with this product.
